description: This Harvard Dataverse release assembles potato field experiments from temperate, subtropical and tropical settings for crop-model comparison. It covers 87 experiments and 204 treatments that vary fertiliser, irrigation, carbon dioxide, temperature, cultivar and site. The records include tuber fresh and dry weight in every experiment, with other growth, nitrogen and soil water measurements in some. Soil characteristics and daily weather inputs accompany the experiments in AgMIP format. The public named page shows version 2.2 and CC0 1.0; it labels the older RAR file outdated and supplies a newer 7Z archive. A food-supply modeller could use the observations to calibrate or test potato-yield simulations and examine irrigation or heat responses. The sites are a selected experimental sample, not a representative census of global potato farms. Treatment protocols and missing fields must be checked before cross-site pooling. The archives were not downloaded or parsed. No directly related catalogue record was found in the full identity scan.
name: Data from global field experiments for potato simulations
